intro: Lake Skulker Moss is a biological reagent gathered from the amphibious threshadon beasts inhabiting the northern reaches of Lake Lordamere. It was identified by Apothecary Berard, before Arugal's curse claimed his mind, as a key organic component for the Royal Apothecary Society's research into brewing a New Plague.

p: Harvested from the hides and shells of Lake Skulkers and Elder Lake Skulkers on the Dawning Isles, this damp aquatic moss possesses properties prized by Forsaken alchemists. Before Arugal's curse claimed his mind, Apothecary Berard meticulously cataloged the flora and fauna of eastern Silverpine Forest, concluding in his journal that both Lake Skulker and Lake Creeper mosses could serve as stabilizing or reactive agents. After Berard became a mindless servant of Arugal, his journal was recovered from Pyrewood Village for Apothecary Renferrel, who instructed Forsaken champions to gather moss samples alongside a rare tumor from local Vile Fin murlocs, delivering them directly to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
